fulltext.en: This systematic review aimed to evaluate and compare the safety and effectiveness of dTMS with that of high-frequency rTMS (HF-rTMS; >=10 Hz) in individuals diagnosed with major depressive disorder (MDD).
fulltext.zh: 本系统综述旨在评估并比较 dTMS 与高频 rTMS（HF-rTMS，≥10 Hz）在重性抑郁障碍（MDD）患者中的安全性与有效性。

fulltext.en: Two RCTs (n=203) investigating the efficacy and safety of dTMS (n=100) versus HF-rTMS (n=103) in adult patients with MDD met the inclusion criteria. The two included studies were of high quality, with a Jadad score of >=3. Among the two RCTs, the overall antidepressant response rate was significantly higher in the dTMS (60.0%) than in the HF-rTMS group (41.7%).
fulltext.zh: 2 项比较 dTMS（n=100）与 HF-rTMS（n=103）治疗成人 MDD 疗效与安全性的 RCT（共 203 例）符合纳入标准，均为高质量研究（Jadad 评分 ≥3）。两项 RCT 中，dTMS 组总体抗抑郁应答率（60.0%）显著高于 HF-rTMS 组（41.7%）。

fulltext.en: Although medication has demonstrated greater effectiveness in treating MDD than placebo, it is associated with side effects. Further, only one-third of the patients with MDD achieve remission after initial antidepressant therapy. Consequently, a key strategy to manage MDD is developing and testing novel therapies, such as high-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (HF-rTMS), deep TMS (dTMS), transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS), and transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS).
fulltext.zh: 尽管药物治疗 MDD 优于安慰剂，但伴随副作用；而且初始抗抑郁治疗后仅三分之一患者达到缓解。因此，管理 MDD 的关键策略是开发与检验新疗法，如高频 rTMS、深部 TMS、经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）与经颅交流电刺激（tACS）。

fulltext.en: In the case of coil types, the Hesed coil (H1-coil) generates a wider electric field than the F8-coil, thereby addressing concerns over target localization in clinical practice. Moreover, the deep magnetic field created by dTMS has been suggested to enhance white matter recruitment and facilitate propagation to the subcortical areas, potentially improving antidepressant response to TMS.
fulltext.zh: 在线圈类型方面，Hesed 线圈（H1）产生的电场比 F8 线圈更宽，从而缓解临床实践中对靶点定位的顾虑。此外，dTMS 产生的深部磁场被认为可增强白质募集并促进向皮质下区域传播，可能改善 TMS 的抗抑郁应答。

fulltext.en: Two independent investigators systematically searched six online databases (Chinese Journal Net, WanFang, PubMed, the Cochrane Library, PsycINFO, and EMBASE) up to July 6, 2023. Additionally, hand-searching of the references from the included studies and the relevant reviews was conducted independently by two investigators to identify any additional studies.
fulltext.zh: 两名研究者独立系统检索 6 个在线数据库（中国知网、万方、PubMed、Cochrane Library、PsycINFO、EMBASE）至 2023 年 7 月 6 日；并独立手工追溯纳入研究与相关综述的参考文献，以识别其他研究。

fulltext.en: A total of 203 patients with MDD were enrolled in the two RCTs that compared dTMS (n=100) with HF-rTMS (n=103). Among them, 43.3% of the patients were male, with a median age of 23–51 years. All patients received treatment at the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (L-DLPFC) for 2 or 4 weeks. In the included RCTs, dTMS (18Hz) was administered at an average dose of 1,980 pulses per session, whereas HF-rTMS (10 Hz) was provided at 1,400–3,000 pulses per session.
fulltext.zh: 两项比较 dTMS（n=100）与 HF-rTMS（n=103）的 RCT 共纳入 203 例 MDD 患者，其中 43.3% 为男性，中位年龄 23–51 岁。所有患者均在左侧背外侧前额叶（L-DLPFC）接受 2 或 4 周治疗。dTMS 为 18 Hz、平均每次 1980 个脉冲；HF-rTMS 为 10 Hz、每次 1400–3000 个脉冲。

fulltext.en: According to previous meta-analyses, depression severity demonstrated greater reduction after 20 sessions than after 10 sessions of dTMS or HF-rTMS. In the included RCT by Filipcic et al., dTMS resulted in a significantly greater response rate than HF-rTMS after 20 sessions. In contrast, Yang et al. found that the response rates were not statistically different after 10 sessions of dTMS versus HF-rTMS. Therefore, at least 20 sessions may be required to obtain clinically meaningful effects in patients with acute MDD.
fulltext.zh: 据既往 meta 分析，无论 dTMS 还是 HF-rTMS，20 次治疗后抑郁严重度的下降大于 10 次。Filipčić 的 RCT 中，20 次后 dTMS 应答率显著高于 HF-rTMS；而 Yang 等在 10 次后未发现两者有统计学差异。因此，急性期 MDD 患者可能至少需要 20 次治疗才能获得有临床意义的效应。

fulltext.en: dTMS is associated with a better antidepressant response than HF-rTMS in adult patients with MDD, although both treatment modalities have favorable safety profiles. However, additional RCTs employing rigorous methodologies are warranted.
fulltext.zh: 在成人 MDD 患者中，dTMS 的抗抑郁应答优于 HF-rTMS，尽管两种治疗方式的安全性均良好。然而，仍需更多采用严谨方法的 RCT。
